intro: The Huge Gnoll Claw is an unmistakable trophy taken from Hogger, the massive gnoll prowling southwestern Elwynn Forest. Sized far beyond any normal gnoll talon, it serves as the official proof of demise required by the Stormwind authorities in Goldshire.

p: For months, the brute Hogger has terrorized the southern woodlands of Forest's Edge, shrugging off patrols and overwhelming every effort by the local garrison to corral or subdue him. Outmatched and stretched thin across Elwynn, the Stormwind Army posted an open bounty on the beast's head. Marshal Dughan at Goldshire demands undeniable evidence before disbursing the reward funds, and the brute's oversized claw offers undisputed confirmation that the terror of the woods has finally fallen.
